name: search-card
title: Search Card
description: A centred search bar that rises and morphs open into a card of recent searches.
docs:
Search Card — A centred search bar that rises and morphs open into a card of recent searches.

The stylesheet sits next to the component and is imported by it, so keep the two together in components/pinui/.

It is drawn in Be Vietnam Pro (400 to 600). If your project does not already load that face it will fall back to your system sans.

It comes in two themes: pass theme="dark" for the dark one, or wire the prop to your own theme switch.

It listens for ⌘K / Ctrl K on the whole window while it is mounted; pass shortcut={false} if your app already uses that key. It keeps the room the open card needs — the bar rests in the middle of it and rises to the top as the card opens — so give it that height rather than overlaying it on content. A press outside closes it — anything marked data-keep-open (a theme switch, say) is left alone.
